content:
erica_ae: FYI Summit FinServ just escalated to execs. Renewal is gating on 60 QPS sustained + p95 <150ms for 2k-gen paths, plus a certified HSM import flow (they want zero-knowledge import). Can we triage?

matt_solutions: Copy. Who's owning perf vs security? I can coordinate the bridge.

erica_ae: Need perf spec + security Q answers + commercial concession (short-term commit). CTO asked for a one-page exec runbook before the call.

lia_se: Performance side: Dedicated with 4xA100 + pinned model + aggressive KV caching looks good. We measured ~62 QPS local with p95 ~138ms at batch=6. I'll dump the micro-bench.

nora_eng: Running an end-to-end canary now. Config: batch=6, max_seq=2048, kv_cache=on, quantize=int8. Posting logs in a sec.

ops-bot: Canary deploy request submitted: cluster=dcdedicated-gamma, requester=nora_eng. status=queued.

nora_eng: Canary results (summary): sustained 60 QPS, p50=72ms, p95=145ms under 10m run, mem ~92GB. Tail spikes when cold-starting shards. Suggest warm pool + prefetch.

lia_se: Note: we can push p95 down by 10-20ms with kernel retuning and batch tuning; tradeoff is slightly higher median.

devon_security: On KMS: zero-knowledge import + HSM attestation is doable but requires steps: (1) customer creates import-wrapping keys in their HSM, (2) we accept wrapped keys and perform attestation, (3) we store only wrapped keys, never plaintext. Need to confirm which HSM family (AWS CloudHSM vs Thales vs Azure). Attestation usually 48-96h.

erica_ae: They mentioned FIPS 140-2 + Yubikey-backed HSM appliances. Legal will want a no-retain clause.

carl_legal: We can produce a short "key custody addendum". Need the exact import API and confirmation of no key material retention. Can someone paste the import flow?

nora_eng: Import flow (draft):
``n
1. customer generates wrapping key in their HSM (PKCS#11/CloudHSM)
2. customer wraps model key and uploads via secure import endpoint
3. redwood validates attestation token and stores wrapped key blob
4. decrypt-only operations use HSM wrapping/unwrapping via ephemeral session
```

rebecca_finance: Commercial: we can offer a 3-month pilot rate with a 15% reserved discount if they commit to baseline of 40 QPS average. For exec signoff we might need a one-time professional services fee to cover HSM integration.

matt_solutions: Action items: (A) lia/nora: perf runbook + canary logs; (B) devon: draft KMS answers + expected attestation SLA; (C) carl: draft addendum; (D) rebecca: confirm discount + PS fee. I'll schedule a 09:30am bridge with their CTO.

ivy_cust_success: I'll prep a customer-facing 1-pg runbook: success criteria, rollback, risk matrix, slack bridge link.

ops-bot: Deploy update: dcdedicated-gamma-canary -> in-progress (2/4 nodes ready).

lia_se: Putting perf summary in drive: https://redwood.internal/summit/perf-summary (private link). Key numbers + config.

devon_security: Drafting questionnaire answers. Early Qs: do we retain keys? No. Do we support FIPS HSMs? Yes, via wrapped-import. Do we provide per-tenant isolation? Yes. Will share answers by 5pm.

erica_ae: Great. Heads-up to sales: call tomorrow morning may ask for a demo of import flow and attestation screen. Can engineering demo the attestation proof?

nora_eng: We can demo the attestation log (sha256 of wrapping key certs + timestamp). I'll prepare a sanitized screenshot.

carl_legal: I'll prepare the addendum draft and post a redline. Need a positive confirmation from devon that we never persist unwrapped material.

rebecca_finance: Confirming PS fee sketch: $12k integration fee for the import + attestation work (one-time) plus 15% off reserved for 12mo if baseline met.

matt_solutions: Scheduling bridge invite now. Please drop docs here when ready so I can attach to the invite. ETA for all artifacts: 8 hours.

ops-bot: Canary finished: dcdedicated-gamma-canary -> success. avg_p95=142ms over 15m. artifacts: /deploys/dcdedicated-gamma/2026-03-23/logs

erica_ae: Thanks team. I'll prep the email to Summit execs with the runbook + commercial outline and the caveat about attestation timing. If all docs land we'll aim for exec signoff on the bridge. :pray:
